description: Lock Bypass Village focuses on non-destructive physical entry, latch manipulation, custom bypass tool fabrication, alarm sensor defeat, and access-controlled door vulnerabilities.

talks.title: DIY Bypass Tools
talks.teaser: Demonstrates how to design, fabricate, and field-test custom DIY bypass tools using readily accessible workshop materials.

talks.title: Bypass 101
talks.teaser: An introduction to mechanical lock bypass principles, latch slipping, shimming, and non-destructive physical entry methods.

talks.title: Alarms and Access Controlled Doors
talks.teaser: Examines sensor mechanisms, request-to-exit bypasses, and alarm defeat techniques on commercial access-controlled doors.
